title: Scroll-spy contents
notes: Highlighting the section you are reading used to take an IntersectionObserver, a map of ids to links and a class swapped by script. `scroll-target-group` turns plain fragment links into scroll markers, and the browser marks the current one with `:target-current`.

The links still work everywhere as ordinary anchors with smooth scrolling; only the live highlight is Chromium-only for now. Following a link also scrolls the page itself so the article comes into view.
